verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a full-service Indian law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product, so registrable outbound HTTP webhooks are a category error for this kind of offering. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any programmatic event or webhook capability that would make the axis apply; the publications listing and the 404 llms.txt probe are unrelated to webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
